title: Research: 80-helper anticipatory borrowing component and exact price rejection (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

**Fixed local construction and scoped price rejection; no admitted supplier or new κ.** Adds `research/anticipatory-dirty-borrowing/` only.

On the source-pinned selected complex word, an explicit change of address reference and initial compensation reduces helpers **480 → 400**. The completed local rank profile is `{1:2382,2:445,3:406,4:128,5:42,8:8}`, with mass **5276 instead of 5586**, including COPY64 and full logical cleanup.

The witness includes 48 high-helper aliases, 32 additional low-helper aliases, 64 fixed initial compensation terms, 48 early cleanup gates and 40 preserved cold outputs. Every low lender is checked to equal its restored initial dirty input at handoff; all compensation reads initial frame-zero helpers and uses monomial operators. The verifier applies that fixed compensation **before** the original preconditioner and replays all **624 independent inputs**. It never repairs a final error.

Every column of all **160 exact Gaussian handoff/exit products** passes, including scalar phases. The private zero buffers are used only during final inverse cleanup, with no recursive child live.

## Verification and exact limitation

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/anticipatory-dirty-borrowing
```

Passed locally on Python 3.12 / NumPy 1.26.4, including the registered optimized entry point: source pins, chronology/frame constraints, complete free-operator replay, cold/buffer restoration, all 512 columns of each local product, four external mutations and embedded missing-basis/inverse controls. Receipts are checked canonically; normal replay writes no tracked files. Hosted CI is separate.

The copied, credited exact interval engine prices the complete local proposal under favorable fractional idle packing. For nine stages the primitive ceiling lies in `[0.001754331546940,0.001754331546941]`. Every tested odd-stage model still rejects `a=0.00177`. These ceilings are not attained supplier savings or κ values.

Full native chronological lowering, both hosted orientations, whole-call ownership, precision/tape, work constants, the bit rail and strict outer assembly remain open. This package makes no unrestricted borrowing or clean-scatter hosting claim and changes no selected-result pointer.

The selected PR1042/1094 provider/controller lineage, Ali Romman's fixed-block extraction, Thomas DiFiore's block discovery, general Clifford normal forms and Douglas Colkitt's interval engine retain explicit credit and pins. `OVERLAP.md` distinguishes fixed-frame optimality, restored-host cut-rank and P104 temporal-cut results. `OPEN-PR-AUDIT.json` records all 460 open PR titles/heads/body hashes reviewed in the final snapshot; this was metadata screening and detailed related-claim review, not an audit of every code diff.

The other campaign timeouts and greedy failures remain local; they are not submitted as impossibility theorems. Prepared by Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review or full theorem formalization is claimed.
